# VARS Aquaculture

> VARS Aquaculture is a B2B supplier of bio-enhanced live feed, hatchery inputs, certified salmon eggs, and Mediterranean seafood, shipped worldwide from Türkiye. Customers are hatcheries, fish farms, feed producers, and seafood importers.

VARS Aquaculture (varsco.com) supplies: fish meal, vital wheat gluten, potato protein meal, and krill meal for feed formulation; certified fertilized Atlantic and Coho salmon eggs plus decapsulated Artemia cysts for hatcheries; live Artemia cysts and Chlorella microalgae for larval rearing; and fresh Mediterranean seafood (sea bass, sea bream, amberjack, trout, flounder, shrimp, blue crab, oyster) for export. The company is based in İzmir, Türkiye, and serves international B2B buyers with cold-chain logistics and TRACES-compliant export documentation. The site is available in English, Turkish, Arabic, German, Russian, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, and Spanish (path-prefixed, e.g. /tr/, /de/).
